{{DISPLAYTITLE:Clothing in ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''}}
[[File:ClothingStores-GTASA-Interaction.png|thumb|250px|Purchasing '''clothing''' in {{SA}}.]]
'''Clothing''' in {{SA}} allows the player to extensively customize clothing the player's character wears using the [[wardrobe]] room, down to accessories. Articles of clothing are categorized by the stores they were purchased from, following by the types of clothing, including:

*'''Torso''': Tops (shirts, jackets, tank tops, etc.)
*'''Legs''': Bottoms (pants)
*'''Shoes''': Footwear
*'''Watches''': Wristwatches, worn on the player character's left wrist
*'''Chains''': Necklaces
*'''Shades''': Glasses or masks
*'''Hats''': Headgear

Clothing has a 4% influence on overall [[respect]], and 50% on [[Statistics#Sex Appeal|sex appeal]].

==Clothing Stores==
There are six different clothing stores from which clothes can be bought. Each has a fitting room, where [[Carl Johnson]] may "try on" items before purchasing them. Once an item is purchased, the name of the item changes from blue to green text; any article of clothing purchased at one of these clothiers is immediately worn by Carl and made available at his wardrobe, which can be found in his [[Save Points in GTA San Andreas|safehouses]].

However, if Carl already owns an article of clothing and wishes to change to it at any corresponding clothing store, he will be required to repurchase that item, making wardrobe changes at clothing store impractical after the initial purchase. Some of the clothing articles on sale, especially in the stores unlocked earlier in the game, are available in green, the [[Grove Street Families]]' gang color.

Shooting or aiming a weapon at anyone inside any of these stores will cause Carl to be unable to purchase any clothing until he exits the store and re-enters it.

==Special Outfits==
Special outfits are specialized clothing sets that are awarded to Carl via [[Missions in GTA San Andreas|missions]] and [[Girlfriends in GTA San Andreas|girlfriends]], provided in sets that encompass the top, bottom and shoes. While seemingly depicted as independent sets of outfits, the clothes are in fact simply added over Carl's normal combination of clothing, as his normal top, bottom and shoes are still being worn. The watch, hat, necklace and glasses remain visible if Carl wears any of them while he is in a special outfit.

If Carl is [[Busted|arrested]] or [[Wasted|killed]], his clothing reverts to the same clothing that he was wearing before he equipped the special outfit upon respawning, while the special outfit in question remains available at the wardrobe.

==Trivia==
*Unlocking all clothing stores is possible via the [[Jetpack]] [[Glitches in GTA San Andreas#Free Access of Bridges and Shops At The Beginning|glitch]] in the beginning [[Cutscenes|cutscene]] of the first storyline. This does not count for special outfits, however.
